_note: STARTER calibration gold set — labels are Claude's best guess for Robert to CORRECT. Distinct from the nine scoring visions. gold_borderline=true marks the deliberate adjacent<->off_domain seam plants.

vision.purpose: A personal cookbook where a home cook saves recipes and pulls up something to make from what's already in the kitchen tonight.
target_audience: Home cooks who save recipes from around the web
People deciding what to cook with what they have on hand

pantry_match.description: The cook lists what they have on hand and gets saved recipes they can make right now, ranked by how well the recipe fits the available ingredients.

recipe_capture.description: Save a recipe from a URL or a photo of a page into the personal cookbook as clean, structured recipe text.

candidates.name: ingredient_semantic_matching
candidates.rough_description: Matches the cook's on-hand ingredients to recipe ingredient lists by meaning (e.g. 'scallions' matches a recipe calling for 'green onions'), so pantry_match ranks recipes the cook can actually make.
candidates.note: pantry_match cannot produce its ranked result without fuzzy ingredient matching — necessity, cite pantry_match.

candidates.name: recipe_extraction_from_page
candidates.rough_description: Takes a recipe URL or photo and extracts structured fields (title, ingredients, steps) for storage.
candidates.note: recipe_capture's stated outcome (clean structured recipe text) requires this — necessity, cite recipe_capture.

candidates.name: quantity_normalization
candidates.rough_description: Normalizes messy ingredient quantities and units ('a couple cloves', '1 c.') into a consistent structured form during capture.
candidates.note: Part of producing clean structured recipe text for recipe_capture.

candidates.name: ingredient_substitution_suggestions
candidates.rough_description: When the cook is missing an ingredient, suggests plausible substitutions they could use instead.
candidates.note: Fits the 'cook from what you have tonight' purpose, but no feature requires it — enhancement, not necessity. Cite purpose.

candidates.name: dietary_tagging
candidates.rough_description: Automatically tags saved recipes (vegetarian, gluten-free, dairy-free) from their ingredients.
candidates.note: Reasonable for a personal cookbook audience; not required by any stated feature.

candidates.name: shopping_list_generation
candidates.rough_description: Builds a shopping list of the ingredients the cook is missing for a chosen recipe.
candidates.note: Fits home-cook purpose; adjacent to pantry_match but not necessary to it.

candidates.name: restaurant_recommendation
candidates.rough_description: Recommends nearby restaurants serving dishes similar to the cook's saved recipes.
candidates.note: The vision is a personal cookbook for cooking at home; dining out is a different product.

candidates.name: fitness_calorie_sync
candidates.rough_description: Estimates calories per recipe and syncs them to the cook's fitness tracker.
candidates.note: No health/fitness signal anywhere in the vision's purpose or audience.

candidates.name: social_cooking_feed
candidates.rough_description: A social feed showing what recipes the cook's friends are making and letting them comment.
candidates.note: Vision is explicitly personal; no social/community surface is implied.

candidates.name: multilingual_recipe_translation
candidates.rough_description: Detects a saved recipe's language and translates it into the cook's language.
candidates.note: SEAM: home cooks 'save recipes from around the web' (audience) makes translation arguably a purpose fit — but there is no explicit language signal, so it could be off_domain. Genuinely close.

candidates.name: meal_plan_calendar
candidates.rough_description: Lays saved recipes across a weekly calendar to plan meals ahead.
candidates.note: SEAM: plausible for the audience, but 'plan ahead' pulls against the vision's stated 'what to make tonight' framing — could be off_domain.

candidates.name: wine_pairing_suggestions
candidates.rough_description: Suggests a wine to pair with a chosen recipe.
candidates.note: SEAM: pairing touches cooking, but nothing in the vision's purpose (save + cook from pantry) implies beverages — leaning off_domain, but a defensible adjacent.
